title: FHFA House Price Index — Quarterly Index with Monthly Tables (December 2026 and 2026Q4), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: FHFA: two FHFA primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06, independently of the sweep that proposed this id. (1) fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) — its "2027 HPI Release Dates" table reads "Tuesday, February 23 | Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables) | December 2026 and 2026Q4", the second of twelve dated 2027 rows (Jan 26 -> Dec 28, every one a last Tuesday, with the quarterly editions on Feb 23 / May 25 / Aug 31 / Nov 30). (2) The published 2026Q2 report (HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes, released 2026-08-25), whose "FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2027" appendix page carries the identical row and states above it: "Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET and include a press release, tables, figures, and associated data" — a published document, not a second reading of the same web table. notes: PROPOSED by the fhfa-hpi-2027-01-26 initial-research sweep (2026-09-06) and researched the same day; the proposal file is now shadowed by this canonical one. INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-06 (docs/research/events/fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23.md) CONFIRMS the proposal's central claim and upgrades it from an observation about 2027 to a CALENDAR IDENTITY. The proposer noted the 2027 FOMC calendar has no February meeting; what this session measured is that this is structural, not a 2027 quirk, and it is the exact mirror of the proposer's own 8-of-8 January finding. Across all 56 meeting pairs on the Board's posted calendar there are ZERO February day-ones, exactly ONE February decision day ever (2023-02-01), and NO FOMC day of any kind after February 10. The mechanism is arithmetic: FHFA publishes the last Tuesday, the FOMC's March meeting has opened on the third Tuesday of March 7 of 7 times, and lastTue(Feb) + 21 days == thirdTue(Mar) is an identity that holds for every year 1990-2060 with no exceptions. So all six February FHFA releases since 2021 sit at EXACTLY 21 days from the nearest FOMC day, and 21 is the MAXIMUM of that distance distribution across all 68 releases (median 13, min 0). Zero of six are inside an FOMC blackout against 23 of 68 overall. 2027-02-23 is 27 days past the Jan 26-27 decision and 21 days before the Mar 16-17 day one, with fomc-blackout-start-2027-03-06 landing 11 days after it. It is the furthest from the Fed an FHFA release can structurally get. ALSO MEASURED, and it kills the proposal's other reason: the QUARTERLY EDITION IS NOT A DIFFERENT ANIMAL ON THE TAPE. Quarterly release days (n=23) vs monthly (n=45) since 2021 separate on nothing -- VIX close p=0.63, SPX |c2c| p=0.40, VIX9D/VIX p=0.80, VIX range p=0.69. AND A TRAP IS DOCUMENTED FOR THE NEXT LANE: February release days do show VIX range 2.740 vs 1.560 at p=0.0445, which is the ONLY sub-0.05 reading in 20 tests run here and does NOT survive its control -- ALL February sessions since 2021 run 2.060 vs 1.540 (p=0.0003), and February release days against other February sessions are 2.740 vs 2.040 at p=0.3675. February is a volatile MONTH in this sample; the release contributes nothing. IMPACT STAYS low: unlike the January sibling this session is quiet because nothing else is on it, which is the point of the event, not a reason to raise the tier. What this edition uniquely carries is the 2026Q4 QUARTERLY series, which no sibling ledger has read: from FHFA's own hpi_po_us_and_census.xlsx (142 USA quarterly observations, 1991Q1 -> 2026Q2) the last 12 quarters are 12 of 12 positive q/q at a +0.907% median while the same 36 months were only 30 of 36 and the last 12 months only 8 of 12 -- aggregation, and 7 of the 8 quarters since 2012 containing a negative month still printed positive. symbols: [] and 0 hits for any house-price keying in trade-playbooks.md or multi-symbol-sweep.md (re-grepped 2026-09-06); nothing here licenses an entry.
